alignmentMethod: Offline exact-text DTW for every spoken paragraph; physical boundaries centered in independently measured -42dB quiet intervals. Word times are model estimates.
cutPolicy: Near the center of the longest measured quiet interval; a cut may move less than 2 ms within that silence to avoid the MP3 decoder’s 47-sample tail floor. Complete contiguous source ranges are retained.
